ev.q: a case of meningococcal disease in a woman aged 75 years was reported to the Colorado Department of Public Health and Environment
Neisseria meningitidis isolates from both patients were found to be serogroup C at the CDPHE laboratory.
These cases represent a possible instance of meningococcal disease transmission within a family

methods_quotes.q: Whole genome sequence (WGS) analysis at CDC found that both isolates had the same sequence type
The blood isolate was determined to be serogroup C via slide agglutination and real-time polymerase chain reaction (real-time PCR) testing
Antimicrobial susceptibility testing indicated both isolates were pansusceptible.
